name: Store-operated entry survey (ORAI, and the gate that is not a pore)
description: ORAI1-3 across the tree-of-life panel, with STIM1/STIM2 in the sister panel rather than the query. Both proteins produce the same current and the same immunodeficiency when lost, and only one of them is a channel (hazard HC5) - so this preset is also the smallest complete demonstration of what the catalogue's CHANNEL_ASSOCIATED status is for.
